la_hook: Watch f(x) close in as x creeps up on a point.
la_stage_aria: Graph of f near the approach point: {title}
la_step_intro_caption: Here is f. Something odd happens at x = 1.
la_step_predict_predict_caption: What is f(1)? Drag the marker to your guess.
la_step_predict_answer_caption: Plugging in 1 gives 0/0: f(1) is undefined. Yet the curve clearly heads for 2.
la_step_approach_caption: Slide x toward 1 from both sides. f(x) closes in on 2: the limit.
la_step_zoom_caption: Zoom in as far as you like: the curve looks straight, with one point missing.
la_step_value_caption: Now f(1) = 3. The limit is still 2: it only looks near 1, never at 1.
la_step_jump_caption: From the left f heads to 2, from the right to 0. They disagree: no limit.
la_step_oscillate_caption: Near 0, sin(1/x) swings ever faster. Zoom in: it never settles, so there is no limit.
